note: Structural uses raw marginal on ADP-curve (no explicit replacement). First fork is on a shared board; later picks diverge. UI stays marginal.

contract.missing_policy: missing_identity / missing_weeks never score as 0; only observed_zero and observed_points enter eval_outcomes
contract.starter_scoring: Same greedy FLEX-aware lineup_ev as production; headline Δ uses starters only (bench recorded separately). IR not drafted.
